definitions.explanation: Material worked into soil to enrich it, especially animal manure and compost. A more earthy, everyday word than {肥料|ひりょう}, the term used on product labels and in agriculture.

definitions.gloss: nourishment for one's growth; something that makes a person better
definitions.explanation: Figuratively, an experience — usually a painful one — that feeds later development. Used almost exclusively in the pattern 〜を{肥|こ}やしにする.

examples.english: I put manure on the field.

examples.japanese: ⟦{牛|うし}→牛：01857_ushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ふん⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{肥|こ}やしにして⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{育|そだ}てている→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧。
examples.english: They grow vegetables using cow dung as fertilizer.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{土地|とち}→土地：02226_tochi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{肥|こ}やし⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{作物|さくもつ}→作物：02823_sakumotsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧⟦{育|そだ}たない→育つ：01951_sodatsu⟧。
examples.english: This land lacks fertilizer, so crops don't grow well.

examples.japanese: ⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{肥|こ}やし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To make failure into nourishment for growth.
Hardship while you're young becomes nourishment for you later on.

examples.japanese: ⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧⟦{批評|ひひょう}→批評：03581_hihyou⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{肥|こ}やしだ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{考|かんが}えれば→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧、⟦{素直|すなお}→素直：00391_sunao⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{聞|き}ける→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
examples.english: If you think of harsh criticism as nourishment for yourself, you can take it in without resistance.

notes:
The noun of ⟦{肥|こ}やす→肥やす：28712_koyasu⟧ (to fatten, to enrich). The figurative sense is far more common in conversation than the agricultural one.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {肥|こ}やし⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦やる→やる：02980_yaru⟧/まく: to apply, spread manure
- ⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{肥|こ}やし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to learn and grow from failure
- ⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{肥|こ}やし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: for experience to become nourishment

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{肥料|ひりょう}→肥料：06102_hiryou⟧: fertilizer — the neutral technical term, including chemical fertilizers
- ⟦{堆肥|たいひ}→堆肥：06471_taihi⟧: compost — specifically decomposed plant and animal matter
- {糧|かて}: sustenance, food for the spirit — a more literary word for the figurative sense
